learning_objective: 🎯 By the end of this chapter, you will learn about the massive bodies of water and the giant puzzle pieces of land that make up our beautiful planet!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: If you look at the Earth from space, the big patches of land you see are called continents. There are seven of them, and Asia is the biggest one where we live!
Most of our Earth is covered in salty water called oceans. These deep, blue waters connect all the continents together and are home to millions of sea creatures.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🧩 The Earth as a Jigsaw Puzzle
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Millions of years ago, all the continents were squished together in one super-giant landmass. Over time, they slowly drifted apart to where they are today!

fun_activity.title: 🗺️ The Map Master Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Open a world map and try to point out the continent of Antarctica. Then, see if you can trace your finger from India across the Indian Ocean to Australia!

quick_recap: ⭐ Continents are the huge landmasses on Earth, and there are seven of them.
⭐ Oceans are the massive bodies of saltwater that cover most of our planet.
⭐ Earth's land and water are all connected, making it a beautiful blue marble in space.
